web_search.instructions: Is web search required to fulfill this request?

criteria.true: The request explicitly asks to search, browse, look up, find online, or use web search, or requires current, recent, live, external, or internet-only information.
criteria.false: The request can be fulfilled using available context, provided files, or existing knowledge without accessing the web.

code_execution.instructions: Is code execution required to fulfill this request?

criteria.true: The request requires running code, executing a program, performing programmatic calculations, computational data processing, or programmatic file manipulation.
criteria.false: The request can be fulfilled without actually executing code.

file_processing.instructions: Is processing a newly provided file required?

criteria.true: The current request requires processing a newly provided PDF, Word document, spreadsheet, text file, CSV, ZIP archive, or other non-image, non-audio, non-video file.
criteria.false: No new file requires processing, the file was already processed and stored, or a dedicated capability handles it (image_analysis, audio_processing, video_processing).

image_analysis.instructions: Is analysis of a newly provided image required?

criteria.true: The current request requires analyzing, interpreting, extracting information from, or comparing a newly provided image.
criteria.false: No new image requires analysis, the image was already processed and stored, or the request is to generate or modify an image.

audio_processing.instructions: Is processing newly provided audio required?

criteria.true: The current request requires transcribing, analyzing, extracting information from, or converting newly provided audio.
criteria.false: No new audio requires processing, the audio was already processed and stored, or the request is to generate or modify audio.

video_processing.instructions: Is processing a newly provided video required?

criteria.true: The current request requires analyzing, summarizing, transcribing, extracting information from, or converting a newly provided video.
criteria.false: No new video requires processing, the video was already processed and stored, or the request is to generate or modify video.

criteria.true: The user asks to create, generate, draw, make, edit, modify, or transform an image, picture, illustration, artwork, photo, or graphic.
criteria.false: The request does not require creating or modifying an image.

criteria.true: The user asks to create, generate, make, edit, modify, or transform a video.
criteria.false: The request does not require creating or modifying a video.

criteria.true: The user asks to create, generate, make, edit, modify, or transform speech, voice, music, or sound effects.
criteria.false: The request does not require creating or modifying audio.

criteria.true: The user explicitly requests creating, generating, exporting, or delivering the result as a PDF.
criteria.false: The user does not request a PDF as the output format.

criteria.true: The user explicitly requests creating or delivering an editable document, such as a Word document or DOCX file.
criteria.false: The user does not request an editable document as the output format.

criteria.true: The user explicitly requests creating or delivering a spreadsheet, such as an Excel, XLSX, or CSV file.
criteria.false: The user does not request a spreadsheet as the output format.

criteria.true: The user asks to create or deliver a presentation, PowerPoint, PPTX, slide deck, slideshow, investor deck, or pitch deck.
criteria.false: The user does not request a presentation or slide-based output.

none.instructions: Are none of the above capabilities required?

criteria.true: The request can be fulfilled using existing knowledge, reasoning, conversation context, or text generation without any of the capabilities above.
criteria.false: At least one of the capabilities above is required to fulfill the request.
